hyperliquid_data_time.description: Collection time (UTC ISO-8601) of the most recent successful Hyperliquid main+xyz batch (v0.22, stage 2026-08-23-hyperliquid-funding-compare-v1). Optional so pre-v0.22 snapshots still validate; the current producer ALWAYS emits it. null = never succeeded, failed this cycle (atomic main+xyz group), or offline. This timestamp is the ONLY discriminator between row-level hyperliquid:null causes (no HL counterpart vs source unavailable) — no warning token exists. Failure/never-succeeded is never papered over with a warm last-good time.

base_asset.description: Resolved spot leg's base asset (SNXXB for a bStock, BONK for 1000BONKUSDT) — single-point truth shared with the positions merge (2026-08-07 unified-resolver).

collateral_cap.description: Platform collateral-cap (maxCollateralExceededAsset) state for the row's resolved SPOT base asset (v0.9, stage 2026-08-02-spot-order-routing-cap-display-v1). Optional: legacy rows without the key still validate; the producer always emits it. exceeded=true = the asset is on the platform cap list; false = read succeeded and not on it; null = the read failed (unknown) OR the row has no tradable spot leg (see asset). checked_at is the platform-level read completion time, shared by every row in a snapshot (null on failure). asset is the resolved spot base asset (TSLAB for a bStock, never the contract TSLA); null only when the row has no tradable spot leg. Direction is NOT consulted. Display-only: never drives routing, sorting, filtering, or open/borrow gating.

funding_sum_24h.description: Settled funding-rate sum over the inclusive last 24h window [data_time-24h, data_time]. Not annualized. Null when the window is empty or data_time unknown.

annualized_funding_24h.description: Estimate-derived 24h annualization (daily_funding_rate * 365), or null when the daily rate is null. Settled history never mixes in.

annualized_funding_7d.description: Settled 7-day calendar-window funding-rate sum * (365 / 7), or null for an empty window. Estimate/lastFundingRate never mixes in.

annualized_funding_30d.description: Settled 30-day calendar-window funding-rate sum * (365 / 30), or null for an empty window.

hyperliquid.description: Read-only Hyperliquid same-口径 funding values for the first four rate columns (v0.22, stage 2026-08-23-hyperliquid-funding-compare-v1). Optional so pre-v0.22/offline rows still validate; the current producer ALWAYS emits the key. null = no HL counterpart (exact-name + category check failed, deny-listed, delisted, alias/multiplier symbol) OR the whole source failed/is offline — distinguish via the top-level hyperliquid_data_time, never via row content. dex: which HL universe the match came from (main / xyz). funding_1h is the raw hourly funding estimate (decimal string, raw precision); daily_rate = funding_1h x 24; annualized_24h = daily_rate x 365 (same Decimal chain as the Binance 24h annualization; HL settles hourly). funding_sum_24h / annualized_7d come from a SEPARATE per-coin fundingHistory sweep (same cursor/TTL as the Binance history component) and stay null until that cursor reaches the coin. Pure display projection: no filter/sort/borrow/order logic may read it.

funding_sum_24h.description: Sum of settled HL funding in the inclusive 24h window ending at data_time (not annualized) — same window helper as the Binance 近 24h column. null when the rolling history cursor has not covered this coin yet, or its per-coin fetch failed; the first four HL cells are unaffected (history is a second, per-coin dimension independent of the atomic main+xyz group).

annualized_7d.description: Settled 7-day calendar-window annualization of HL funding (sum x 365/7) — same helper and denominator as the Binance 年化 7D column. null under the same conditions as funding_sum_24h.

opening_quotes.description: Additive row-level opening quotes (2026-07-bookticker-open-columns-v1). Optional: legacy rows may omit the whole object and still validate; the current producer always emits a complete object. *_spread_pct are already-multiplied PERCENTAGE-POINT decimal strings (e.g. "-0.04" means -0.04%), NOT fractional rates — do NOT multiply by 100 again. About-60s public reference quotes, not an execution guarantee; last-good is publishable for at most ~2 cycles (default 120s) before status goes stale.

updated_at.description: UTC completion time of the most recent successful paired bookTicker fetch; null only when the pair never succeeded (unavailable). Retained on stale.

spot_bid_price.description: Spot best bid (reverse numerator left operand), or null when missing/zero/non-string.

spot_ask_price.description: Spot best ask (forward denominator / subtrahend), or null when missing/zero/non-string.

futures_bid_price.description: Futures best bid (forward minuend), or null when missing/zero/non-string.

futures_ask_price.description: Futures best ask (reverse denominator / subtrahend), or null when missing/zero/non-string.

forward_spread_pct.description: (futures_bid - spot_ask) / spot_ask * 100, ROUND_HALF_UP to 2 places, percentage-point decimal string (no '%' char); null when that direction's operands are not both valid >0.

reverse_spread_pct.description: (spot_bid - futures_ask) / futures_ask * 100, ROUND_HALF_UP to 2 places, percentage-point decimal string (no '%' char); null when that direction's operands are not both valid >0.

cross_margin_free.description: Unencumbered PM full-cross balance from papi balance.crossMarginFree (raw decimal string | null). Additive/optional: frozen pre-2026-08 samples omit it. Display-only availability — NOT a max-transferable quote (a transfer out must also clear uniMMR / collateral constraints) and never added into total_value_usdt.

cross_margin_locked.description: PM full-cross locked quantity from papi balance.crossMarginLocked (raw decimal string | null). Additive/optional for frozen older samples; display/validation-only and never added into total_value_usdt.

cross_margin_borrowed.description: PM full-cross margin liability from papi balance.crossMarginBorrowed (raw decimal string | null).

cross_margin_borrowed_value_usdt.description: Backend-computed ≈USDT value of cross_margin_borrowed (8dp string | null). Display-only liability; null/blank/zero borrow -> 0.00000000; invalid amount or non-zero missing price -> null. Not included in total_value_usdt.

cross_margin_interest.description: PM full-cross OUTSTANDING interest from papi balance.crossMarginInterest (raw decimal string | null) — interest accrued and not yet repaid, a live liability separate from the cross_margin_borrowed principal. Additive/optional for frozen older samples. NOT comparable to the interest-history ledger sum: after any interest repayment the history sum can exceed this field.

cross_margin_interest_value_usdt.description: Backend-computed ≈USDT value of cross_margin_interest (8dp string | null). Same valuation path as cross_margin_borrowed_value_usdt; display-only and not included in total_value_usdt.

total_value_usdt.description: Partial sum of the account sources that read this round: spot_value_usdt + unified net worth (pm_account.actual_equity_usdt). A source that did not read contributes NOTHING and the frontend renders the total red — there is NO fallback to accountEquity or to unified wallet gross (2026-08-17; before that date the unified side fell back to wallet gross, so values recorded earlier are not comparable).

unified_wallet_value_usdt.description: Σ(unified totalWalletBalance priced); wallet gross, not net equity.

pm_account.description: Portfolio Margin account summary from GET /papi/v1/account (additive). Null fields when channel off or fetch failed.

account_equity_usdt.description: papi accountEquity — the collateral-discounted risk figure (measured ~4% below actual_equity_usdt on 2026-08-16). Carried for its own sake; it is NOT a net-worth substitute and must never back a card labelled net worth, nor enter total_value_usdt.

actual_equity_usdt.description: papi actualEquity — unified account net worth, the figure the Binance App shows. This is the unified side of total_value_usdt and the divisor of leverage_ratio. Null means the source did not read (endpoint failure, or the upstream field disappeared); consumers must degrade to an explicit unknown, never to another equity basis.

uni_mmr.description: Unified maintenance margin ratio (equity / maint margin). Higher is safer.

total_debt_usdt.description: Priced sum of (crossMarginBorrowed + crossMarginInterest) on unified balances — principal plus outstanding unpaid interest. The two do not overlap: borrowed only absorbs interest that was already accrued at the moment of a past repayment (visible as a changed interest_rows.principal), while crossMarginInterest carries what accrued since.

leverage_ratio.description: total_value_usdt / actual_equity_usdt, but ONLY when the total is complete. Null whenever the spot source did not read or actual_equity_usdt is absent — even though both operands are positive in the first case, because the numerator then degenerates to the net worth itself and the ratio reads a false 1.00. A spot fetch returning a genuinely empty array is not missing and yields a real 1.00. Same equity source as the net-worth figure so the on-screen division stays self-consistent (2026-08-17: divisor changed from accountEquity, ratio steps down about 3%).

source.description: papi_v1_account when account endpoint contributed; null when unavailable.

source_checked_at.description: Fixed five-key per-source success-time metadata (v0.10, stage 2026-08-03-hedge-status-account-refresh-v1). Always emitted (all five keys present). Each value is the UTC ISO-8601 moment this service last successfully obtained AND wrote that account/valuation source into its cache, or null when it has never succeeded (cold start / PM capability absent for pm_account). A failure keeps the last-good value and its old time (does NOT advance). This is a source-read success clock, NOT a quote-freshness clock, a page-render time, or the snapshot publish time; it does not change checked_at / valuation.priced_at (the kept-back aggregate). price_map is valuation data and is included for completeness classification and the partial-source notice, not for a per-account panel title.

pm_account.description: null when the PM capability (GET /papi/v1/account) is absent; the key is still present.

unavailable_sources.description: Account sources this assembly did NOT obtain (F4, 2026-08-07). The judgement is the input being None -- the fetchers use None for disabled/failed and [] for 'read it, genuinely empty'. The `or []` degradation that follows would otherwise erase that distinction, leaving consumers unable to tell 'not read' from 'really nothing' -- which is how the positions table came to print an exchange-has-no-position claim over rows the account actually held. Always emitted; an empty array means every account source was obtained. Names mirror source_checked_at minus price_map (not an account source). An empty array must never be read as 'unknown'.

notional_usdt.description: Absolute UM position value in USDT (from notional or |amt*mark|).
